description.en: Ariana, born into a politically arranged marriage, was nothing more than a tool, used and abused by her family her entire life. On her 28th birthday, she was tragically killed, yearning for a love that never came. Perhaps out of pity, a mysterious force sent her back to when she was 16. Reflecting on her painful past, she makes a vow: "I shall beg for love no longer. I will never love nor be loved again."
description.ko:
정략 결혼으로 태어나 가족들에게 평생 이용만 당한 아리아나는 누구도 기억해주지 않는 28살의 생일, 사랑을 갈구하다 처참하게 죽었다.
안타까웠던걸까. 무언가의 힘으로 회귀하여 16살로 되돌아 오게 되고.
처참한 지난 삶을 곱씹으며 그녀는 결심한다.
"더 이상 사랑을 구걸하지 않겠어. 두 번 다시는 사랑하지도, 사랑받지도 않으리라."
고결한 자리에 앉아 천박한 마음을 갖고 있는 그대들의 인정을 결코 원하지 않으리라.
그리고 그들에게 복수해 주리라!

description.en: Chosen by the last remaining Seabird, Lott has been cursed with a target on her back. After the notorious Woohoppiage pirates pillage her village and kidnap her sister, she embarks on a perilous journey to get her back. And she’ll do whatever it takes to make that happen, even if that means joining the Black Ocean crew and pretending to be a man. But she's not the only one with a secret on this pirate ship…
description.ko:
[여자는 허락하지 않는 바다. 여동생을 구하기 위해 바다와 맞서 운명을 바꾸려는 로트의 이야기.]

"네가… 이 마을에 죽음을 불러온 거야. 
너랑 그 빌어먹을 새가!"

전설로만 남은 줄 알았던 바다새 발카의 주인이 된 로트는 
해적 우홉피아주의 습격으로 엄마를 잃고 하나 남은 여동생마저 납치 당한다.
우연히 '우홉피아주'를 쫓고 있는 또 다른 해적 '검은바다'를 만난다. 
                       
"무슨 일이 있어도 동생을 구해야 해.
날 검은바다에 받아줘! 내가 쓸모 있다는 걸 증명할게!"
 
졸지에 남자로 오해 받은 로트는 '검은바다'의 선원이 될 자격을 얻지만,
'검은바다'는 여자를 허락하지 않는다는 걸 알게되고 
랄티아를 찾을 때까지 여자임을 숨기기로 한다.

과연 로트는 자신이 여자라는 사실과 발카가 바다새라는 것
이 모든 비밀을 지키고 여동생을 구할 수 있을까.

description.ko:
20살, 달콤한 멜로디와 함께 다시 나타난 너…


갓 스물이 된 아현은 친구들과의 술 약속을 위해 홍대 밤거리로 나간다.
그때 그녀의 귓가에 울려 퍼지는 매력적인 보컬의 버스킹 소리. 
평소 밴드 덕후인 아현이기에 관심을 가지고 다가가는데… 들을수록 낯익은 목소리?
"이해랑…?!!"
몇 달 전까지 같은 반이었던 존재감 없던 남자아이. 우연히 밴드 공연을 함께 보고 난 후 
친구가 될 수 있을 거라 생각했지만 갑자기 자퇴를 하고 사라져버린 아이.
그의 왼쪽 귀가 들리지 않는다는 비밀만 공유한 채 시간 속에서 지워진 아이.
그 아이가 지금 아현의 앞에서 노래를 부르고 있다.
궁금해졌다. 그가 자퇴를 한 이유도, 음악을 시작한 이유도, 지금 여기 서있는 이유도…

description.en: The story revolves around four young people. After the death of the president of Sung Han Group, a very prominent group in the world, the heir was to be decided. In the midst of all the commotion, his biological granddaughter was discovered, Jung Hween-Lin, and brought to live in the main house. Though kind and softhearted at first, the money changed her and she became very spoiled and obsessed with her bodyguard, Han Jae-Ha. Han Jae-Ha was initially raised by the president to become the successor of Sung Han Group, but instead now he's become nothing more than a Jung Hween-Lin personal bodyguard and head of the security in Sung Han Group. In order to fully protect her he hires a policeman, Baek Suk-Ho, who despite his old age looks very young and fits in immediately in the high school that they are attending.He joined the police force so he could legally beat up people and doesn't care much about rules or the consequences his actions produce. On one of his missions he meets up with Yoon Lee Sem, a biker gang's leader, who with just a few sentences convinces him to destroy his police cars and makes a breakthrough. Almost causing him to lose his job because of that, he reluctantly accepts the mission to guard Jung Hween-Lin. He then meets up with Yoon Lee Sem once again at high school, who looks completely different from the last time he saw her, which makes him not recognize her at first and befriend her. She, too, becomes Jung Hween-Lin's bodyguard, for unknown reasons, and it seems that Han Jea-Ha and her known each other from before, which adds more to Baek Suk-Ho's suspicion about this whole mission.

Kangha lost her boyfriend, her job, and, most recently, her bike. And just when things were at their worst, she meets her neighbor. Tall, handsome, mysterious… in a word, perfect. That is, except his tendency to transform into a frog.

K is a wizard who can grant wishes–all he asks in return is that which is most precious to the wisher…  
Mourning from a horrific loss, Jin Ryu wants K to bring back her parents and brother from the dead. But when K tells her that a wish such as this can only lead to greater tragedy, he agrees to take her on as an apprentice. Now Jin observes K with his various and sundry clients: A father who wants to put a stop to his son's relationship… A young woman who longs for her lover to remember… A boy who will do anything to be accepted…

A new student arrives at Andromeda High School, where troubled children from all over the universe gather.

The protagonist is the next president, who went through every high school on earth with violence that burst into school and no longer had a place to go will eventually be transferred to Andro High School.

Will the next chef survive at Andro High School, a jungle of superpowered aliens? The goal is to graduate! The adventure begins!
After getting bullied for months, Evelyn finally makes friends in school. Is this friendship or love? Find out what happens to the friends!
Hot on the heels of the bestselling Warcraft: The Sunwell Trilogy comes a stunning and truly awesome collection of original adventures set in the Warcraft universe.

Eunsoo’s life is a fairy tale. She’s a ballerina living in New York and her romantic boyfriend just proposed to her with a huge diamond ring. So what if she didn’t get the lead role this time? All the other dancers are jealous of her perfect life, and that’s all that matters. But when Eunsoo receives a call saying her boyfriend committed suicide, her fairy tale quickly turns into a nightmare she can’t wake up from.
description.ru: Жизнь Ын Су похожа на сказку. Она танцует в труппе нью-йоркского балета, а ещё встречается с милым и понимающим парнем, который делает ей предложение и в качестве подарка преподносит кольцо с огромным бриллиантом. И уже плевать, что ей не досталась главная партия в грядущем представлении. Её жизнь настолько идеальна, что она постоянно ловит завистливые взгляды коллег. Однако, волшебство не длилось вечно. Сказка превращается в кошмар, когда Ын Су узнаёт, что её жених покончил с собой.

description.en:
‘Hexagon’ is the center of money, fame, and all power.
A group of people losing their way in a world where success is the only answer.

Everyone dreams about Seung-Ha, the perfect prince, the shining star of the school. Chasing after the perfect prince is definitely not easy. For Nan-Woo, Seung-Ha was just a dream far, far away. However, sometimes dreams exist to come true! But when Nan-Woo’s dream comes true, it comes at an expensive price. Who knew the perfect prince was actually a big jerk?! (From: Yen Press)  
  
Licensed in English by Yen Press as *You're So Cool*.

description.en:
Marrying your childhood best friend and first love may sound like a dream come true – but not for Renée. After engaging in a contract marriage with Alexander, Renée faces all sorts of trouble, but none can match her own husband’s cold shoulder. However, a magical wish might change everything. Can a simple wish save Renée’s failing marriage?

---
Renée’s first love from childhood, Alexandre Chambler. Upon hearing the news that he had lost his mother, she rushed to his side— only to be met with a cold rejection and the heartbreak of her first love. Then one day, that very first love proposed to Renée. Thus began their contract marriage. Throughout the marriage, he had been indifferent— but 48 days before the divorce, he suddenly began to change? Will Renée and Alexandre’s contract marriage come to a smooth end?
description.id: Cinta pertama Rene saat ia masih kanak-kanak adalah Alexander Chambler, yang kini menjabat sebagai direktur perusahaan otomotif dan merupakan pria paling terkenal di Kaliba. Untuk menghindari perhatian ratu yang ingin menjadikannya suami, Alexander datang mencari Rene dan mengajaknya menikah. Di luar, mereka pura-pura mesra, namun hubungan Rene dengan cinta pertamanya tidak terjalin dengan baik. Di penghujung pernikahan kontraknya, Rene diberikan kalung oleh nenek Alexander yang konon bisa mengabulkan permintaan pemiliknya. Meski tak terlalu percaya dengan kekuatan kalungnya, Rene berharap agar Alexander bisa bahagia, dan tak lama setelah itu, sikap Alexander yang tadinya dingin dan menyebalkan berubah total! Apa alasan di balik perubahan sifatnya itu?
description.ko:
어린 시절 '르네'의 첫사랑 '알렉산드르 챔블러'. 
그가 어머니를 잃었다는 소식에 한 걸음에 달려갔지만, 
돌아온 건 싸늘한 거절과 첫사랑의 좌절이었다. 

그러던 어느 날, 르네에게 그 첫사랑이 청혼해왔다. 
그렇게 시작된 계약 결혼 생활. 
결혼 생활 내내 무관심하던 그 남자가 이혼을 48일 앞둔 그날부터 갑자기 달라졌다? 

르네와 알렉산드르의 계약 결혼은 무사히 종료될 수 있을까?
description.ru: Контрактный брак — дело прагматичное. Особенно если у тебя нет выбора, а в «мужьях» — холодный, но слишком знакомый мужчина. Спустя два года Рене решила: хватит. Она хочет новой жизни, приключений и настоящей страсти… Но её «бывший» внезапно начал вести себя так, будто всё только начинается.
description.th: อเล็กซานเดอร์ แชมเบลอร์ คือรักแรกในวัยเด็กของเรเน่ เมื่อเธอได้ยินข่าวการจากไปของคุณแม่ของเขา เธอก็รีบไปหาเขาในทันที แต่สิ่งที่ได้รับกลับมา คือการปฏิเสธอย่างเย็นชาและความผิดหวังจากรักแรก กระทั่งวันหนึ่ง... อยู่ดี ๆ อเล็กซานเดอร์กลับมาขอเธอแต่งงาน?! และชีวิตการแต่งงานด้วยพันธสัญญาของเธอและเขาก็เริ่มต้นขึ้น ชายผู้ไม่เคยมีท่าทีสนใจเธอเลยตลอดชีวิตแต่งงาน กลับเริ่มเปลี่ยนไปในวันที่เหลือเวลาอีก 48 วันก่อนหย่า…? การแต่งงานของอเล็กซานเดอร์และเรเน่จะจบลงอย่างราบรื่นได้ไหมนะ?

description.en:
Kim Wisheen, who has the ability to handle spirits, is pursuing one particular spirit for revenge. The only clue he has about this spirit is its golden eyes. Before he was able to get his hands on a crucial clue as to the whereabouts of this spirit, his 5 years of efforts were instantly rendered meaningless at the hands of Park Eero and his ghost exorcising stone. All of Wisheen's spirits and spirit artifacts he had collected disappeared!

With the addition of Dongbaek, the daughter of a tiger, rather than being able to take his revenge, Wisheen is slowly being encumbered by hindrances...

title.en: The Witch of the Capital, Mirinae

altTitles.en: The Shaman of the Capital, Mirinae

description.en:
Eunhasu, who was an ordinary university student in South Korea, suddenly, finds herself living in the Joseon era as a shaman named 'Mirinae'?!

A street shaman in Joseon, named 'Mirinae,' was doing a gut, a Korean shamanistic ritual dance. At the moment she said, "Oh God, descend upon us!", a 21st-century History major, fourth-year student Eunhasu possessed her!

Amidst the confusion of this unwanted time travel, Eunhasu, who was a student of history, begins to use her expertise to gain a reputation as the capable shaman Mirinae?!

"Since it's turned out like this, I guess I have to make a living as a shaman. After all, starving to death is not an option, right?!"
description.fr:
Eunhasu était une étudiante ordinaire en université en Corée du Sud, se retrouve soudainement vivant à l'époque Joseon (renaissance coréenne 1392-1897) en tant que chamane nommée 'Mirinae' !

Un peu plus tôt, une chamane de rue à l'époque Joseon, nommée 'Mirinae', exécutait un gut, une danse rituelle chamanique coréenne. Au moment où elle prononça, "Oh Dieu, descends à nous !", une étudiante en quatrième année d'histoire du 21e siècle, Eunhasu, l'a possède !

Au milieu de la confusion de cette possession imprévue, Eunhasu, qui était une étudiante en histoire, commence à utiliser son expertise pour se faire connaître en tant que la compétente chamane Mirinae !

"Puisque les choses se sont déroulées ainsi, je suppose que je dois gagner ma vie en tant que chamane. Après tout, mourir de faim n'est pas une option, n'est-ce pas ? !"
description.ko:
대한민국의 평범한 대학생이었던 은하수! 갑자기 조선시대 무당 '미리내'로 살게 된다?!
조선의 돌팔이 무당이었던 '미리내'가 굿을 펼치며 "신이여 내려오소서!” 하는 순간! 21세기 역사학과 4학년 은하수가 빙의해버렸다!
혼란스러운 것도 잠시, 역사학과였던 은하수는 전공 지식을 활용하여 용한 무당 미리내로 소문나기 시작하는데?!
“이렇게 된 이상 무당으로 먹고살아야지, 굶어 죽을 순 없잖아?!”

description.en: While being harassed by a group of gangsters, Lee June is saved by a handsome foreigner named Lucion. To his surprise, this total stranger then claims that he is his fiancé and shows him their ring. As it turns out, he is the same Lee June as the one from another world, whom Lucion loves

"If you become ten times stronger, I will become a hundred times stronger!"

Lim Han is becoming even stronger.

Corrupt politicians, wicked businessmen, and the gangster who oppressed the weak, all have no choice but to cower in the face of a new hero.

Now, the forces of evil have only one enemy, and they must fight against Lim Han!

Suspicions arise about the seemingly perfect son-in-law's affair!
As a dog-turned-dad, protect your daughter from the unworthy son-in-law."

description.en: I am a successful woman in her 30's excelling at her career. But I guess the tables turn when life seems too perfect. It is just my luck that I woke up as Camilla Elchasis, a character in my favorite novel whose life is filled with trouble. After possessing Camilla's body, I first need to get rid of my ridiculous fiancé and his mistress who are fooling around in my house. I must also deal with my half-sister and father who wish to kill me. Meanwhile, why is Duke Caliet so obsessed with me? "You started it, so I'll finish it."
description.fr: Pour reprendre sa vie en main, Camilia Elchasis cesse de jouer les gentilles. Fini de se faire humilier par son fiancé, de subir le mépris de la noblesse, de se faire maltraiter par sa famille. Sa nouvelle attitude de méchante plaît même à l’imperturbable duc Caliet… mais ses ennemis ne lui laissent pas de répit, elle va devoir redoubler d’astuce pour les affronter et trouver les bons alliés dans un monde sans pitié.

“사람은 뿌린 대로 거두는 법이랍니다.”

그러던 내가 하필이면 구구절절 사연만 가득한 카밀라 엘카시스트 백작 영애의 몸에 빙의해 보니 거슬리는 것들이 너무 많다.   

바람 피우는 약혼자, 호시탐탐 날 노리는 가족! 

목숨을 걸고 이능을 발현하면서까지 그들의 뜻대로 되지 않도록 노력하느라 나는 더더욱 악독해지는데... 
그런데 왤까,  그럴수록 칼리에트 대공이 내게 집착하는 것은.
description.ru: Я успешная 30-летняя женщина, преуспевшая в своей карьере. Но все изменилось в тот момент, когда моя жизнь стала слишком идеальной. Так случилось, что я проснулась Камиллой Эль-Хасис, героиней моего любимого романа, чья жизнь полна неприятностей. Теперь для начала, мне нужно избавиться от моего глупого жениха и его любовницы, которые дурачатся в моем доме. А также я должна разобраться со своей сводной сестрой и отцом, которые собираются убить меня. И кстати, почему герцог Калиет так одержим мной? «Ты начала это, так что я закончу».

과거 더할 나위 없이 행복한 시간을 함께 보냈던 사남매와 반지.

앞으로도 영원할 거라 생각했던 시간은 갑작스럽게 끝이 났고, 백영은 반지와 멀어지게 된다.

둘은 다시 직장에서 재회하게 되지만, 여전히 반지는 백영을 밀어내는데….

이에 백영은 반지를 다시 놓치고 싶지 않아 끝까지 그녀에게 다가간다.

과연 백영과 반지는 예전처럼 다시 함께 할 수 있을까?

Everyone doesn't recognize her because she's the complete opposite of school, and even adult men don't know that she's a high school student and begs Se-kyung to meet her. description.ko: "야야 저기 니 여친 지나간다ㅋㅋ" "뭐?죽을래?" 공부말고는 잘하는 것 하나 없는 이세경. 같은 학교 아이들에게 늘 저런식으로 괴롭힘 당한다. 그런 그녀가 학교만 나가면 인싸녀 그 자체?! 학교와의 정반대의 모습에 모두가 알아보지 못하고 심지어 성인 남자들도 그녀가 고딩인줄 모르고 세경에게 만나달라고 애걸복걸하는데. 사람들을 속이며 재미 좀 보려는데 뭐야, 저건? 하필 걸려도 같은 반의 앙숙인, 하선우한테 정체를 들키는데?! 어른도 아닌, 그렇다고 아이도 아닌 청소년들의 방황,사랑,청춘. 달콤매콤 톡톡쏘는 사춘기 로맨스가 시작된다!

They protected humanity against whales using mysterious powers, and the Fishermen’s leader Grinard’ is admired as a hero who saved humanity. biography.en:
김금숙
GENDRY-KIM Keum Suk 
GENDRY KIM Keum Suk 
Keum-Suk Kim

Keum Suk Gendry-Kim was born in the town of Goheung in Jeolla Province, a town famous for its beautiful mountains and sea. Her graphic novels include The Song of My Father, Jiseul, and Kogaeyi, which have been translated and published in France. She also wrote and illustrated The Baby Hanyeo Okrang Goes to Dokdo, A Day with My Grandpa, and My Mother Kang Geumsun. She received the Best Creative Manhwa Award for her short manhwa “Sister Mija,” about a comfort woman. She has had exhibitions of her works in Korea and Europe since 2012, and her graphic novels and manhwa deal mostly with people who are outcasts or marginalized.

Yeon Woohyuk was once a veteran player of the martial arts detective game The Great Detective of Daehwan Empire Then suddenly, without warning, he finds himself reincarnated as a pokoe (detective officer) inside the game!

Fortunately, he realizes that the cases from the game unfold exactly as he remembered, so he begins to adapt by solving them.

But the joy is short-lived—he discovers that his ability known as "Spirit Eye" is actually the result of his dantian (energy core) being forcibly opened, putting him at risk of an early death.

Being a detective is hard enough —  and now he has to learn martial arts and become a powerful master too?!

Depois de apenas um dia de apresentações nesta nova vila, alguém destruiu os instrumentos de Go Jin e de sua trupe musical. Sua busca pelo culpado leva-o a Gam-rae, o mestre taoísta da aldeia. Dotado de dons sobrenaturais, a suspeita geralmente recai sobre ele. Mas Go Jin logo descobre que há muito mais neste homem do que em seus dons, pois ele fica preso no meio da batalha sobrenatural de Gam-rae.

description.ru:
Слабый и болезненный бастард Ферд Роснов был фактически выброшен собственной семьей: его насильно обручили с великой герцогиней Вальдровой и изгнали из дома. Ведомый лишь слепой яростью и жаждой мести, Ферд пробудил в себе магию. Обладая колоссальным талантом, он возвысился до великого мага и обрушил свою кару на предавший его род и весь мир.

На пике своего гнева, желая достичь Девятого круга — божественного величия, — он отправился на поиски своей суженой, Красного Дракона Вальдровы. Однако тот вместо битвы добровольно отдал свое сердце, пожелав ценой собственной жизни унять бушующую в нем ненависть.

Познав всю глубину чувств и тяжесть пути, что прошла Вальдрова, Ферд впервые осознал, насколько чудовищной и пустой была его собственная жизнь. Обретя силу Девятого круга, своим последним желанием он повернул время вспять и вернулся в прошлое.

И вот пред ним вновь роковой миг — день его «помолвки».

— Я официально принимаю помолвку с великой герцогиней Вальдровой.

На этот раз он не станет бежать. Он делает этот выбор сам и делает шаг навстречу Вальдрову. Не ради власти и не ради мести, а ради самой обычной жизни — просто чтобы быть рядом.

description.en: Mun Su is a strong girl with a weak heart. Wanting to pay off the debt of her uncle, she is going to work for the creditor. To her surprise, the guy she beaten up outside is…!!! (You can guess where this is going.)

biography.en: Not an actual artist, but a pseudonym created by the Korean magazine Kkotnim to publish a mass amount of "house style" manhwa.

description.ko:
세상에서 착한 게 제일 싫은 준영은 '자타공인 청정호구' 산호가 자꾸 거슬린다. 
취향이 없고 흐릿~한 것도, 맨날 손해보고 사는 것도 마음에 안 든다.
그런데... 산호의 목숨을 살리려면 이 순둥이를 나쁜 남자로 변화시켜야만 한다고?!
사람 속 긁는 건 타고난 준영이지만, 이렇게까지 해도 되는 거야?

description.en:
A diver has died, but five years of his life have been accidentally destroyed from his blue lantern. Now he must live again. Will he be able to make all the right decisions?

Note on the title and premise: A "lantern", as it relates to this story, is a vessel, floating on the water, that contains the memories of a person's life that they will see when they die.

When a mysterious incident causes Mir to lose her magical abilities, she decides to retire and become a student in a normal school–or so she thought! To her surprise, she's enrolled in a school with a special connection to her family. Will Mir's boring new life keep her from her magical past… and from her divine future?
We were all underdogs at one point of our lives. Sad but true but now it is time for some payback …
description.ko: [언더독]... 유기견, 혹은 사회적 약자들의 처절한 반격!

altTitles.en: The Cursed Attendant of the Duke's Castle
The Cursed Maid in the Duke's Castle
The Cursed Maid of the Duke's Castle

altTitles.ja: 公爵城の呪われたメイド様

description.de: Als Serenity Theophano auf der Straße einen älteren Mann retten will, wird sie von einem tödlichen Fluch getroffen, der ihr Leben frühzeitig beenden wird, wenn sie diesen nicht aufheben kann. In ihrer Verzweiflung versucht sie, die Antwort in Büchern zu finden. Als sie dabei zufällig auf den kalten Herzog Aaron Lorang trifft, verschwindet der Fluch zeitweise wie durch ein Wunder! Um als Bedienstete an seiner Seite zu bleiben und eine Lösung für ihre Probleme zu finden, muss Serenity es jetzt schaffen, das Vertrauen des Herzogs zu gewinnen. Was sie dabei nicht bedacht hat - die wachsende Besessenheit des Herzogs von ihr. Wird Serenity es schaffen, sich rechtzeitig aus den Klauen des Fluchs zu befreien? Und was hat der Herzog damit zu tun?
description.en: When Serenity Theophano rescues an elderly man on the streets, she is inflicted with a deadly curse, solvable only in a limited time. Desperate, she delves into books for a cure until she encounters the cold Duke Aaron Lorang, after which the curse’s brand miraculously disappears! Forced to remain close to the duke as an attendant, Serenity navigates his deep mistrust and suspicion of her. Initially planning to use him to escape her curse, she unexpectedly becomes entangled in a new predicament – the duke’s growing obsession with her. With time running out, can Serenity untangle the curse binding her fate?
description.fr: En essayant de secourir un vieil homme dans la rue, Serenity Theophano se retrouve soudain frappée par une malédiction mortelle, qui ne peut être levée que dans une limite de temps bien précise. Elle passe alors des heures à se plonger dans des livres dans l’espoir de trouver un remède, jusqu’à ce qu’elle rencontre le duc Aaron Lorang, un homme au caractère froid comme la glace. Curieusement, il semblerait que le contact avec ce duc fasse temporairement disparaître la marque de sa malédiction chaque fois qu’elle le rencontre. C’est pourquoi elle décide de rester à ses côtés en tant que domestique, essayant tant bien que mal d’apaiser les soupçons qu’il a à son égard. Alors qu’elle comptait simplement utiliser le duc Lorang comme solution à sa malédiction, voilà que ce dernier devient de plus en plus obsédé par elle. Serenity parviendra-t-elle à changer son destin tragique? Vers où sa relation avec le duc la mènera-t-elle?
description.ko:
“저 여자, 내 눈앞에서 치워” 
  
냉혈한 공작님께 단단히 찍혀버렸다, 하지만 내가 받은 저주를 풀기 위해서는 꼭 공작님과 붙어한다고?! 그렇다면…! 

“제, 제가 각하를 좋아합니다…!!” 

이 위험한 도박이… 통했다? 공작님과 저주와 함께하는 산뜻한 공작성 라이프!

title.en: In the Flower of Our Youth

description.en: Love is hard, even for grown-ups. After a heart-wrenching breakup, Chorong decides to chase her dreams. Three long years of studying for the civil service exam finally come to fruition – her new life is just starting now! But her new workplace brings about an unexpected reunion...
description.ko: 이별 후유증을 극복하기 위해 공무원 시험에 도전한 초롱. 힘겨운 공부 끝에 합격하지만, 첫 발령지에서 뜻밖의 사람을 만나게 된다.

title.en: The Huntress and the Mad Scientist

altTitles.en: The Hunter and the Mad Scientist

altTitles.fr: La chasseuse et le savant fou

description.en:
"I can't log out?!"

Esperanza finds herself trapped in a virtual reality game and unable to log out. Suddenly, she is transported 13 years into the past and finds herself stuck in the eerie mansion of the mad scientist, the Earl of Avenedale. In order to escape, Esperanza teams up with Lord Avendale to complete a quest that will hopefully allow her to return to reality.

A hidden war around the secret of Seoul, the 600 year old capital of Korea. Joo-hee never dreamed he would be investigated in the Presidential Residency by making emergency calls to see the flame from the city center though he felt wrong to know noone else witnessed the flame at school. People from National Fengshui Office said Seoul is in danger, for some people are breaking the seals on the places of bad chi. Indeed, people are killed by unearthly monsters, and not knowing what talent he has, Joo-hee's life is swept to this hidden war.

altTitles.en: A lazy man's switch of desire

description.en: Jaehyun has always gotten everything that he wanted, but the housekeeper's son, Eunhae, was the one person that he desired above anything else. So when Jaehyun heard that Eunhae's moving away, of course he's going to push him down the stairs. Eunhae loses his memory due to the accident, and Jaehyun decides that he will never desire anything ever again. However, an unexpected reunion with Eunhae triggers Jaehyun's desires to come rushing back...

altTitles.en: An Event at Home for Lost Children

description.en: Jang Yumi works at the home for lost children at a department store. Her job is to make them as comfortable as possible until their parents pick them up. But it seems that it is not always easy to take care of these brats…

There's a spy on campus!? 

Elmarid's top student, Evan, gets entangled with the suspicious exchange student, Mari, and begins leading a double life!

Dabin Choi is the daughter of Seoul's most powerful crime boss, and daddy's little girl has the hots for Eugene, the son of one of her father's 'friends'. There's just one problem: Eugene isn't into Dabin. In fact, he thinks of her more like a little sister. (The kiss of death!) To make matters worse, Dabin's new classmate is none other than the son of her father's long-time rival. Soon, everyone at school begins playing power games that would make their fathers proud!

altTitles.en: A Story for the Mermaid Princess

description.en:
A mixture of off-the-wall family comedy and bittersweet love story, For the Mermaid Princess is the story of a girl with a gentle manhwaga father, a whip-wielding nutjob of a mother, and four older sisters.   
When her family moves to a new house, Lee Suelbi discovers just how difficult it can be to balance family, friendships, and love.

Acting tough is the last thing that hell-raising street thugs must worry about when suddenly an orphaned baby lands in their care.

---

title.en: The Bartz: The War of Liberation

description.en: The unique rebellion of users against power! A history we created in Lineage 2.  < A Short story based on the popular game Lineage II >

With a handsome fiancé and a career at a fashion magazine, Jung Dana just about has it all. In order to clinch a promotion, she just needs to get star photographer Park Jihan to do a shoot. Dana manages to convince him, but after the shoot, Jihan disappears and Dana is brutally dumped by her fiancé. Dana bitterly swears off dating, but when she and Jihan run into each other four years later, sparks start flying. Can the two of them overcome their past trauma and find a safe haven in each other?

I came to Yulguk in Wonderland with a friend who said she was a princess in my previous life...Weird. There is an imperial palace in my memory, and seeing the emperor makes my heart pound. 

“I like you a lot." 
“Hey, no, your Majesty. It’s different from just now.” 
"No. I definitely like you, Yulgi. I want and crave you But this heart is ambiguous for love.”

Eventually sparked a debate over who was the actual princess, and we were put to the test. By the way… Oh My God. 

“What is that? What is it, Yulgi-kun?” 

My previous life wasn't a princess, it was the cat that the princess's brother had!

Brother always reject girls around him! Despite having an ideal boyfriend by her side, his charm is still not enough to attract her, because he is always by her side…

A wedding engagement from love between a girl and a guy since they were children (6 years-old and 4 years-old). About ten years later, will their love still be the same? Will they have a happy ending?

Aiden ends up working with his favorite  
novelist, but when he meets him, things  
start to take a different turn…

altTitles.en: Mr. Manager, I’ll Just Hold Your Hand and Sleep

description.en: Baek Dan-hee is a high-level security expert and white-hat hacker who is not only a "top performer" at work but also incredibly quick-witted. However, she has one major problem: whenever it rains, she suffers from such intense nightmares that she cannot sleep at all. Then, one day, she accidentally spends a night with Executive Director Kwon Tae-san of the Taeju Group... and sleeps like a baby? Casting aside her pride, she makes a bold proposal: “Executive Director! I’ll just hold your hand and sleep!” This is a romantic comedy about a talented man and woman who become deeply intertwined through a single incident and begin to heal each other's wounds.

A manhwa one-shot about a girl who is unsure if she should continue the relationship with her longtime lover with a flirtatious past. Should she trust him this time or not? Could he ever change his ways?

As a young girl, AhSoo was involved in a plane accident. Years later, she has tried to move on from the incident. Everything seems to be going well, until she meets a person from her past. A transfer student has arrived at her school, and he is directly responsible for the plane accident AhSoo was involved in years ago.
A boy falls in love with a priest and can never forget.

A horror game where dying means dying in real life.
But I’m the only one who doesn’t die.
There are 5 famous pretty boys at school. Their odd natures disagree with their good looks. Now that Jun-Oh is their target, what will happen?

This is a story about aliens. Yes, aliens. Choi Sera houses displaced aliens in her home, where they all pretend to be UFO fanatics in order to explain their eccentricities. Sera’s job is to teach these aliens how to live in human society—not that difficult on the surface, as they ostensibly look like humans (except for the three fingers on each hand thing). They look normal, and they can communicate with earthlings via a translator that looks like a hearing aid, but can they act normal?  
  
The answer to that is a resounding no. Watch as Sera tries to school the emotionless twins, Seunghyun and Seungmin (really clones) on dating (with disasterous results), tries to keep Hyunwoo out of trouble, and keep them all from being taken away by the UN alien hunter who’s on to them. And what happens when a translator breaks?! Find out in Safe Again Today!  
  
Note: Discontinued after second volume.

Kanghun works as a male escort. He wants to quit since he's in a relationship and doesn't like hiding it from his girlfriend. His life starts to go upside down when a photo of a suspected serial killer is plastered over the media. Is he the killer? Or is someone trying to frame Kanghun?
The sweet life of singles and couples. The sweet episodes of the employed and unemployed… But why is it so bitter?

title.en: My Mother and the Game-room Guest

description.en: This manhwa is a parody of a Korean novel called Sarangbang (Korean room) Guest and My Mother, a story that most Koreans have read. It’s a classic piece about a widow and her child. The widow rents a room in her house to a man, but soon after, the man and the widow have feelings for each other. The key thing here is that the story is told through the eyes of the six year-old child. In this parody, the widow is a “game-junkie” who runs a game room. One day a very handsome man collapses in the game room.

Society is corrupt, but no society is as corrupt as Hanbit High School. Chaseong, a student at the bottom of the school’s social hierarchy, struggles to survive… until he unexpectedly gains a mysterious ally who claims that together, they can uproot it all. But how? No one knows, but one thing is certain, Chaseong’s secret WeTube channel is about to go viral.
description.ko: 흙수저 사이버렉카 고교생. 명문고 학생들의 비밀을 온에어(ONAIR)하다!'세상 모든 이슈를 퍼 나르는 사이버 렉카 고교생 이차성.재벌과 유명인 자제들이 즐비한 명문 한빛고에 사회배려자 전형으로 입학해 고위층 학생들의 비밀스러운 사생활을 목격하게 된다.정체를 숨긴 채 운영 중인 너튜브 렉카 채널에 목격한 사건을 업로드하는 차성. 영상은 큰 인기를 끌지만 차성이 사이버 렉카임을 알고 있는 미지의 인물이 연락해오고,채널이 인기를 얻을수록 차성은 걷잡을 수 없는 사건에 휘말리게 되는데…

description.en: Soo Ah discovers the cafe of dreams, young teahouse while floundering about trying to find a job…. Drinks sweet coffee while listening to baristas tell her of future dreams and hope.
The stories of countless lovers. Crying, laughing, loving and parting. Will they be able to find their happy endings?

A cute love story of a girl who falls in love with the local cafe's cashier. She calls him Pinky because of the apron he wears around the cafe. She frequently visit and one day Pinky is no longer working there. Distraught by this, she takes her time to try and move on from this crush and at her first day at his company she finds Pinky is now a fellow co-worker. How will this end for her and does she get the guy?
Taekwon fights to become the best in RAC but is sucked into another world… This is a story of his path to becoming the greatest.

They embark on a pilgrimage to Antarctica to discover their true identities. 

"Who are we, and where are we going?"
description.pt-br: Uma história de jornada filosófica e existencial em que os personagens embarcam em uma peregrinação à Antártida para descobrir sua verdadeira identidade. Eles viajam ao ponto mais ao sul da Terra — a Antártida — em busca de respostas para perguntas fundamentais: “Quem somos nós, e para onde estamos indo?”

title.ko-ro: Nal Cha Beorin Sokkupchingu wa Jeon Yeochin i Gateun Banira Gollanhada

altTitles.ko: 날 차버린 소꿉친구와 전 여친이 같은 반이라 곤란하다

altTitles.en: In the same class with my childhood friend and my ex girlfriend

description.en:
"I'm sorry... I really like you... but it's different from love."

A loser who had no talent in magic... was born again as a tall, handsome, and powerful wizard!
Upon entering the elite class in the Imperial Academy, he finds himself in the same class as his ex-girlfriend and his childhood friend who dumped him.

(Source: Toptoon Global)
description.fr:
« Désolée… Je t’aime bien… mais ce n’est pas de l’amour. »

Autrefois incapable d’utiliser la magie, Ezio renaît sous les traits d’un jeune homme grand, beau et incroyablement puissant. Lorsqu’il intègre la classe d’élite de l’Académie impériale, il se retrouve dans la même classe que son ex-petite amie et son amie d’enfance qui l’avait rejeté.

altTitles.en: It's My First Time Getting Married

altTitles.ja: 結婚するのは初めてなので

description.en: Yeon Bora is the CEO of Wedding Violet, Korea's top wedding shop. Although she's respected at work, it's the opposite at home, where she's mistreated by her grandmother and cousin, Jiyoung, due to her parents' past. Jiyoung even uses this dark secret to threaten Bora and her business. One day, out of anger, Bora proposes to top star Ahn Dowoon, knowing Jiyoung has her eye on him. But not only does he accept, he actually shows extreme interest! Who knew that he would say yes to a total stranger?!

description.fr: Yonggi a en réalité peur des femmes ?! Yonggi, beau et populaire comme jamais, semble avoir tout. Mais l'apparence peut décevoir, et il joue définitivement la carte de l'escroquerie à long terme. Il n'est pas le Casanova que tout le monde pense ! Un jour, son ancienne camarade de classe, Suyeon, arrive sur son lieu de travail. Sera-t-elle celle qui apaisera enfin son cœur inquiet ?

description.en: On the night of her grandfather´s funeral, Hwang Keum Lin saw a thief trying to steal something in her grandfather´s house. She chase after him trying to catch him before he take away anything valuable but he disappear like magic. Her cousin did not believe her that there was a thief no matter how she try to explain. Luckily nothing was missing. However, what can the thief be looking for and how did he break into the strongest security system that money can buy. Little did Hwang Keum Lin know, this is just the beginning and her life will turn upside down, starting from that moment…and everything she thought she know might not be so…

biography.en: Not an actual artist, but a pseudonym created by the Korean magazine Kkotnim to publish a mass amount of "house style" manhwa.

description.en: A cursed girl's life changes forever when her cat, who lived with her quietly for a long time, shows her his real human form. Fluffy Boyfriend is a love story in a world of half-animal humans secretly living in plain sight.

Yoosu, whose first love is his childhood neighbor, Chungwoo, gets his feelings discovered by Chungwoo's sister, Jiwoo. Jiwoo proposes to the flustered Yoosu that he become her fake boyfriend so Yoosu is able to see Chungwoo more often. But contrary to his initial hesitance about his feelings for the other, after seeing Chungwoo again for the first time in a long time, Yoosu is greedy to get closer to him...
